```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(medicaldata)
```

## Exercise 1: Tumour growth over time

**(1)** The column headers `0` to `28` are values of a `day` variable,
not variable names.

```{r}
tumor <- read_csv("data/tumorgrowth_wide.csv")

tumor_tidy <- tumor |>
  pivot_longer(
    `0`:last_col(),
    names_to = "day",
    names_transform = list(day = as.integer),
    values_to = "size",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )
tumor_tidy
```

```{r}
tumor_tidy |>
  group_by(Grp, day) |>
  summarize(avg_size = mean(size), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
ggplot(tumor_tidy, aes(x = day, y = size, group = ID, colour = Grp)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Tumour size (mm³)", colour = "Group")
```

## Exercise 2: Cleaning a clinical trial dataset

```{r}
opt |>
  count(Birth.outcome)
```

**(1)** The labels end in trailing spaces (`"Live birth          "`).

```{r}
opt |>
  filter(Birth.outcome == "Live birth") |>
  nrow()
```

**(2)** 0 rows,
because `"Live birth"` doesn't match `"Live birth          "`.

```{r}
opt_clean <- opt |>
  mutate(
    Birth.outcome = str_trim(Birth.outcome),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("C", "T"),
                   labels = c("control", "treatment"))
  ) |>
  filter(Birth.outcome == "Live birth") |>
  select(PID, Clinic, Group, Age, BMI, Birthweight, GA.at.outcome)
head(opt_clean)
```

```{r}
opt_clean |>
  summarize(across(everything(), \(x) sum(is.na(x))))
```

**(4)** Only `BMI` has missing values,
in `r sum(is.na(opt_clean$BMI))` of the `r nrow(opt_clean)` live births.

## Exercise 3: Cytomegalovirus

```{r}
cmv <- cytomegalovirus |>
  mutate(
    cmv = factor(cmv, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    recipient.cmv = factor(recipient.cmv, levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("negative", "positive")),
    donor.cmv = factor(donor.cmv, levels = c(0, 1),
                       labels = c("negative", "positive"))
  )

cmv |>
  count(cmv, recipient.cmv, donor.cmv)

cmv |>
  summarize(missing_time = sum(is.na(time.to.transplant)))
```
